scope: Raw (before the smooth fit) ensemble RMS of calibrated pseudo-Stokes Q and U in parent channels, smooth plus speckle, for every local-medium case at the 5 K reference normalization; rescale linearly by an emissivity amplitude factor. Stokes I and leakage are the as-built linear spectra in the same channels. Ensemble RMS, not a band RMS of one realization; conditional on the same assumptions as the local-medium grid.
